title: Parked returns
subtitle: Every parked return across the stores, with its store details and refund ledger rows. Opens on the ones only HQ can move.

access.deniedHint: Parked returns need the parked returns view right. Ask your administrator for it.
access.unreachableTitle: Your access could not be read
access.unreachableHint: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, the server may be down.

list.order: Needs HQ first, then the oldest.
list.failed: The parked returns could not be read.
list.empty: No parked return matches these filters.
list.emptyNeedsHq: No parked return needs HQ right now.

reason.noStatusApi: The partner has no status check
reason.aged: Waiting on the partner for more than 3 days
reason.uncheckedFailure: Failed, and no one has checked it
reason.mixed: Some rows refunded and some did not

parkReason.heldAtCompletion: Held when the return was completed

detail.failed: The parked return could not be read.
detail.noHeader: The store has not sent this return's details yet. The ledger rows below are all HQ has.
detail.noGrains: No ledger row was written for this return.

REFUNDED.title: Mark this row refunded?
REFUNDED.body: Only if you saw the refund of {{amount}} to {{partner}} on the partner's dashboard. The store can then complete the return.

VOID_AFTER_CHECK.title: Void this row after your check?
VOID_AFTER_CHECK.body: The refund of {{amount}} to {{partner}} did not happen and the customer will not be paid. The store will void the return.

cash.title: Pay in cash
cash.hint: The store will pay {{amount}} from the drawer instead of the {{partner}} refund. Both fields are kept with the ruling for audit.
cash.evidenceMissing: Type what the partner's dashboard showed.

rowless.title: Resolve a row-less park
rowless.hint: No refund ledger row was written for this return. Check the partner's dashboard, then record what happened to the refund.

refusal.title: Not saved
refusal.failed: The change could not be saved.
refusal.noSettleRight: You no longer have the right to settle parked returns. Ask your administrator.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_NO_SETTLER: Your session did not say who you are. Sign in again and retry.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_INVALID_OUTCOME: That is not an action the server knows. Reload the page and try again.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_REASON_REQUIRED: Pay in cash needs a reason.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Pay in cash needs what the partner's dashboard showed.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_NOT_FOUND: This row or return no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_ALREADY_SETTLED: Someone already settled this row. It has been refreshed to show what they chose.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_FINISHED_AT_TILL: The store already finished this return at the till, so it can no longer be settled.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_NOT_SETTLEABLE: This row is not in a state that allows this action. It has been refreshed.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_SETTLED_CONCURRENTLY: Someone settled this row at the same moment as you, and theirs was saved first. It has been refreshed.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_INVALID_STATUS: Choose whether the partner refunded it or the refund failed.
refusal.PARKED_RETURN_NOT_ROWLESS: This return already has a refund ledger row. Settle that row instead.
